mapper.insert: insert into abr_tool_run (tool, visitor_id, degree, questionnaire_id, input, result, engine_versions, channel_code, content_code, client_platform, policy_code, policy_version, create_time) values (#{tool}, #{visitorId}, #{degree}, #{questionnaireId}, cast(#{input} as jsonb), cast(coalesce(#{result}, '{}') as jsonb), cast(coalesce(#{engineVersions}, '{}') as jsonb), coalesce(#{channelCode}, 'direct'), coalesce(#{contentCode}, ''), coalesce(#{clientPlatform}, ''), coalesce(#{policyCode}, ''), coalesce(#{policyVersion}, ''), now())
mapper.select: select tool_run_id, tool, visitor_id, degree, questionnaire_id, cast(input as text) as input, cast(result as text) as result, cast(engine_versions as text) as engine_versions, channel_code, content_code, client_platform, policy_code, policy_version, create_time from abr_tool_run where tool_run_id = #{toolRunId} and visitor_id = #{visitorId}
